annotations.title: What is the land around this Houston-area site used for?

description: Use when the user is screening a site in Harris County, Texas (Houston) for development, investment or lending and asks what surrounds it: "what is around this lot?", "how much vacant land is nearby?", "is this block mostly commercial or residential?". Returns the parcels within the radius by land-use category from the Harris County Appraisal District, with counts, appraised value, the vacant share and the site parcel’s class. Houston has no zoning code, so this is land use, not zoning; owner names are never returned. Refuses before you are charged outside Harris County or if the totals do not reconcile. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: one release (current appraisal year); place: address or lat/lon, radius_miles (Harris County); segment: land-use category (in the result). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For who lives around the site, use run_trade_area.
